_comment: Trimmed from the live list_playbooks and list_areas answers of 2026-10-20 (3 of 29 playbooks, collections shortened). Field names and shapes exactly as served.

playbooks.name: oim-db-history
playbooks.title: OIM Database History
playbooks.description: Answer One Identity Manager DB *change-history* questions from the structured `OIM - DB - History` JSON corpus (no manual prose, no citations). Two planes — (a) **schema**: exactly which major release (7.0, 7.1, 8.0, 8.1, 8.2, 9.0, 9.1, 9.2, 9.3, 10.0 — no sub-versions like 9.3.1) and build a table or column was added, dropped, renamed or retyped in; (b) **content**: what differs between two installation kits for config parameters (DialogConfigParm), VB.NET scripts, the full process layer (JobChain processes, Job process steps, JobRunParameter step parameters, JobTask/JobParameter task definitions), mail templates and mail bodies, UI objects (DialogObject) and the module set — for the **8** valid pairs 9.1.3/9.2.1/9.2.2/9.3.1 → 9.2.1/9.2.2/9.3.1/10.0. Does NOT cover Release Notes narrative or system requirements, how OIM features work at runtime or the full schema/code as it ships today, or deployed customer environment data.

playbooks.name: oim-full
playbooks.title: OIM Full Search
playbooks.description: Single-agent full search across the entire One Identity Manager (OIM) standard manual set (163 documents, tags 9.3.1 and 10.0 across Getting Started & Overview, Operations & Configuration, Access Governance, IT Service Management, Developer & API, Release Information, and Target Systems [Basics & Sync, Directory & Messaging, SAP & ERP, Databases, Cloud & Custom, Mainframe & Passwords]) plus the `OIM - Custom - Install Kit` as-shipped database and code graph (23 entity kinds and 20 relationship predicates: tables and columns, views, stored procedures, functions, triggers, VB.NET scripts, process/job chains, configuration-parameter namespaces, mail templates, Manager UI forms, object methods, modules, assemblies, customizers, TypedWrappers, REST/AppServer APIs, sync connectors, process components, CHM SDK docs, and shipped tools). Also carries the **internal experience corpus** `OIM - Field Experience` — practitioner troubleshooting threads (`kind: teams`) for concrete error messages, symptoms and workarounds, and curated Confluence pages (`kind: confluence`) for how-tos, runbooks and recipes — plus gated **web search** (when `WebSearch` is enabled in the active toolset) over the One Identity support portal and community forum when internal collections do not cover the question.

playbooks.name: oim-full-browsing
playbooks.title: OIM Full Browsing (Top-Down)
playbooks.description: Browse One Identity Manager (OIM) manuals top-down through the hierarchical table of contents of the "OIM - Manuals - Hierarchical" collection — discover manuals, read their TOC, then read the relevant section. Text/manual content only: this playbook has no full-text search and no knowledge-graph access, so for database tables, columns, processes or code use a specialist that carries the graph tools.
